xBRIEFInfo.description: Approved change proposal for the Modules 2-3 curriculum scope
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:codex

narratives.Problem: The repository has a complete foundation and Module 1, but learners cannot yet install, diagnose, or orient in a Directive consumer project or resolve competing authority sources without undocumented help.
narratives.Change: Author Modules 2 and 3, a disposable initialization lab, explained solutions, source and command evidence, a small cross-platform proof path, refreshed navigation, and focused content validation.
narratives.Scope: In scope: the files and acceptance clauses declared by training.modules2-3. Out of scope: later modules, capstone work, publishing implementation, deployment, production repositories, Directive framework changes, and upstream issue filing.
narratives.Impact: Adds learner-facing Markdown, disposable fictional lab assets, reference evidence, one small GitHub Actions matrix, and a focused repository check. The training repository remains the authored source; no site is published.
narratives.Risks: Released prose and CLI behavior can disagree; shell behavior can differ by operating system; an unsafe reset instruction could target the wrong repository. Exact version pinning, platform evidence, no-remote guards, and bounded recovery are acceptance requirements.
narratives.Approach: Revalidate the pinned 0.111.0 command and source surfaces, implement the two modules sequentially, execute the lab proof on each claimed platform, then run focused and aggregate gates.
narratives.Alternatives: Splitting Modules 2 and 3 was considered. One sequential story keeps their shared source and navigation work coherent; split only if cross-platform behavior creates a materially independent scope.
narratives.Dependencies: The completed training.foundation-module1 scope, the exact @deftai/directive 0.111.0 pin, Node.js 20 or later, Git, npm, and native platform runners for every path labeled verified.
